title: Junior Crypt 2026 CTF
content:
# Our Traditional Summer CTF Is Coming!

Hello everyone!

Our **traditional summer CTF** is approaching, and we’re excited to welcome you once again!

This year, we’ve decided to make the competition more dynamic by shortening its duration from **48 hours to 24 hours**.

## Task Categories

- **Web**
- **Crypto**
- **Stego**
- **Reverse**
- **PWN**
- **OSINT**
- **Forensics**

Prepare your team, sharpen your skills, and get ready for **24 hours of challenges, creativity, and cybersecurity fun**.

> Whether you’re an experienced CTF player or taking part for the first time, there will be something interesting for everyone.
